visualCharacteristics: "Frequently Requested Services" tab set: a heading, a row of audience tabs (Popular, New Residents, Job Seeker, ...), and per tab a panel of service cards plus an "All citywide services" link.
contentPattern: Rows: heading, one row per tab label, then per panel its card rows (title, text, links) and the closing link row.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for tabbed groups of service cards; plain tabbed text belongs in a simpler tabs block.
